Anforderungen is the requirements section; no optional qualification section appears. Technologies mentioned only under Aufgaben are excluded.
Integrationsarchitekturen is mapped to software-architecture as an explicitly named architectural practice.
Backend-Systemen asks for backend-system knowledge rather than explicitly for development; the backend-development mapping is flagged for review.
Automatisierung is mapped provisionally to workflow-automation; no workflow-specific wording appears.
The final oder in the AI/GenAI/automation/data-driven-applications list is read literally as offering alternatives. The mapped members share group 1; data-driven applications has no fitting taxonomy entry.
Studium has no explicit degree level and therefore maps to bachelor. The explicit alternative of completed vocational IT training is treated as an equivalent qualification, not as making the qualification optional.
